theme: An open Saturday — the day is yours.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday in St. Pete, Dan, with the girls around and nothing on the calendar until tomorrow. The day's real work is light: a little prep so tomorrow's review and meeting run clean, and two travel bookings that have waited long enough.

needsAttention.title: Prep for the Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Your weekly 15-minute review with Mike is at 9 AM — open the "Dan & Mike Stuff" board first so you can clear the inbox, put an owner and date on everything, and kill what's gone stale three Sundays running.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is weeks overdue — that's the hardest rental in the market over the holidays. Book a refundable one now and fix the dates later.

needsAttention.title: December break — pick a destination
needsAttention.detail: Both the decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have passed. All four girls, three weeks, the thinnest holiday inventory of the year — settle domestic vs. international and book.

needsAttention.title: Island annual meeting on Zoom
needsAttention.detail: The DIRA & DIBA annual meeting is at 5 PM tomorrow — the materials were to be emailed separately, so have them open before you join.
